bash ops/pages/tests/test-pages-tools.sh

pages.name: Shell syntax; no new runtime units
pages.command:
for script in ops/pages/*.sh; do
  bash -n "$script"
done
test -z "$(find ops/pages \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.timer' \) -print)"
test "$(find ops/pages -name '*.service' -printf '%f\n')" = mag-pages-reconcile.service
grep -F 'ProtectHome=yes' ops/pages/mag-pages-reconcile.service
! grep -R -E 'pages-policy.sh \*|sudo -n /usr/local/lib/mag-pages/pages-gc.sh' ops/pages
! grep -R -E 'systemctl (restart|stop) (mag-llm|deepseek)' ops/pages

nginx.name: nginx and shell security dependencies
nginx.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nginx openssl jq

nginx.name: Shell syntax and transactional TLS tests
nginx.command:
bash -n ops/private-access/*.sh ops/private-access/tests/*.sh
bash ops/private-access/tests/test-deploy-hook.sh
bash ops/private-access/tests/test-rollback.sh

nginx.name: Actual lego 5.5.2 CLI parsing (no ACME traffic)
Real TLS nginx auth, fail-closed, header spoofing
Cutover guard and rollback contract
nginx.command:
grep -F 'systemd-run --quiet --unit=mag-private-rollback --on-active=180s' ops/private-access/install.sh
grep -F 'systemctl reload nginx.service' ops/private-access/rollback.sh
grep -F 'owner-verified' ops/private-access/confirm.sh
grep -F 'mag-private-cutover/confirmed' ops/private-access/remove-caddy.sh
! grep -E '(systemctl|service) (restart|stop|try-restart) mag-llm' ops/private-access/*.sh
! test -e ops/private-access/tailscale-whois.py
! test -e ops/private-access/mag-whois.service
grep -F 'include /opt/mag-stack/current/ops/nginx/mag-speech*.inc;' ops/private-access/mag-room.nginx.conf
grep -F 'cp -a -- "$site" "$backup"' ops/private-access/install.sh
grep -F 'mode=$(stat -c %a "$backup")' ops/private-access/install.sh
grep -F 'rm -f -- "$backup"' ops/private-access/rollback.sh
! grep -F 'python3 -' ops/private-access/install.sh
grep -F 'proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8766/_internal/tailscale/whois;' ops/private-access/mag-room.nginx.conf

recovery.name: Install restic and test tools
recovery.command:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3 jq util-linux systemd curl bzip2
curl -fsSLo /tmp/restic.bz2 https://github.com/restic/restic/releases/download/v0.18.1/restic_0.18.1_linux_amd64.bz2
echo '680838f19d67151adba227e1570cdd8af12c19cf1735783ed1ba928bc41f363d  /tmp/restic.bz2' | sha256sum -c -
bunzip2 -c /tmp/restic.bz2 | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/restic >/dev/null
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/restic
/usr/local/bin/restic version

recovery.name: shell syntax, executable hook and no destructive model action
recovery.command:
bash -n ops/backup/*.sh ops/backup/tests/*.sh ops/deploy.sh
test "$(grep -Ec '^[a-f0-9]{64}[[:space:]]+' ops/backup/models.sha256)" -eq 5
test "$(grep -Ec '^[a-f0-9]{64}[[:space:]]+' ops/backup/models-iq3.sha256)" -eq 4
grep -Fq 'sha256sum --check' ops/backup/bootstrap-models.sh
grep -Fq '/var/lib/tailscale' ops/backup/backup.sh
grep -Fq '/var/spool/cron/crontabs' ops/backup/backup.sh
grep -Fq 'systemctl start mag-backup-deploy.service' ops/deploy.sh
! grep -Fq 'mag-backup-clear.timer' mag-room/native/routes.hpp
grep -Fq 'actor.role != "owner"' mag-room/native/routes.hpp
! grep -R -E '(stop|restart) mag-llm.service' ops/backup
! grep -R -q 'openssl rand -hex 32' ops/backup/install.sh
grep -Fq -- '--insecure-no-password' ops/backup/common.sh
test -f ops/backup/migrate-passwordless.sh

recovery.name: Validate calendar and systemd units
recovery.command:
for f in ops/backup/units/*.timer; do
  expr=$(sed -n 's/^OnCalendar=//p' "$f")
  [[ -z "$expr" ]] || systemd-analyze calendar "$expr" >/dev/null
done
for f in ops/backup/units/*.service ops/backup/units/*.timer; do
  systemd-analyze verify "$PWD/$f" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mag-unit-verify.out
  ! grep -E 'Failed to parse calendar|Unknown key|Invalid argument' /tmp/mag-unit-verify.out
done
grep -Fq 'NUMAMask=1' ops/backup/units/mag-backup-daily.service
for f in ops/backup/units/mag-backup-{daily,deploy,clear,weekly,monthly,restore-test}.service; do
  grep -Fq 'CPUQuota=15%' "$f"
  grep -Fq 'MemoryMax=2G' "$f"
  grep -Fq 'MemorySwapMax=0' "$f"
  grep -Fq 'Nice=19' "$f"
done
grep -Fq 'CPUAffinity=14-27 42-55' ops/backup/units/mag-backup-clear.service

speech.name: Vendor pinned Moonshine German WASM and model
Playwright with actual WASM and German model
Reject unapproved removal of live files
speech.command:
git fetch --no-tags origin main
# #21 deliberately retires precisely two Python whois artifacts,
# and only with the native C++ LocalAPI replacement in place.
while IFS= read -r removed; do
  [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
  case "$removed" in
    ops/private-access/tailscale-whois.py|ops/private-access/mag-whois.service)
      test -s mag-room/native/tailscale_auth.hpp
      grep -Fq 'proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8766/_internal/tailscale/whois;' ops/private-access/mag-room.nginx.conf
      ;;
    ops/deepseek/both-sockets.sh|ops/mag-120.d/30-multibot.conf)
      # Retired: no executable compatibility paths remain.
      test ! -e "$removed"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unexpected deletion in speech integration: $removed" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D origin/main...HEAD)
